name: Nighthaunt Whisperer

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Death Whisper
traits.details: Any enemy within the aura takes a -2 penalty to Will, and at the start of its turn it takes 5 necrotic damage.

traits.name: Shadow Wing
traits.details: If the whisperer moves at least 8 squares on its turn, it becomes invisible until the start of its next turn.

auras.name: Death Whisper
auras.details: Any enemy within the aura takes a -2 penalty to Will, and at the start of its turn it takes 5 necrotic damage.

effect.description: The whisperer uses claw touch twice. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is grabbed. The whisperer can grab only one creature at a time.

powers.name: Night’s Fell Kiss
powers.usageDetails: when the whisperer uses shadow wing

effect.description: The whisperer shifts up to 2 squares, sliding the creature it has grabbed with it. If the whisperer ends this movement adjacent to no other enemy aside from the grabbed target, it makes the following secondary attack against the creature.
nestedAttackDescriptions: necrotic damage, and the target is stunned (save ends).
